decisions.reason: The parallel commission finalization effect is already fully represented by the candidate's message-688 MODIFY.
The candidate already requires calling processRandomReferral(requestId) after VRF fulfillment; confirming the resulting ticket credit does not change that ingestion obligation.
The candidate's existing message-688 MODIFY already records crediting a no-code ticket to the randomly selected token ID.
The technical finalization timing for processRandomReferral does not necessarily change the user-facing FAQ, whose no-referral allocation copy already states the resulting behavior.
The metadata requirement already requires randomly credited tickets to appear in NFT attributes; message 688 reports a runtime mismatch rather than changing that requirement state.
Finalizing a no-referral ticket allocation does not alter the Small Block prize amount, draw trigger, funding, eligibility window, or reset mechanics.
Crediting a randomly selected NFT with a ticket after processRandomReferral does not change the separate VRF prize-winner selection rules.
The source Event concerns ticket allocation when no referral code is used and does not change ticket issuance to a referrer when a valid code is used.
The accepted backend finalization detail does not necessarily require a change to the About page's higher-level description of referral and ticket behavior.
The no-referral ticket-credit finalization rule does not change the mint price or allocation of mint revenue.
The candidate's message-688 Events already represent the accepted commission count and observed accounting result; the source ticket finalization adds no further commission-accounting state.
Allocating a Small Block ticket to a randomly selected NFT does not change how a later prize is delivered or claimed.
